justification: A is a three-dimensional sculptural composition of stacked blocky forms with an animal-like head and crouching body, rendered as volumetric sculpture in the round; B is a flat wall surface covered with dense horizontal rows of small repeated incised signs, including bird-like and curved shapes. The only correspondence is the generic presence of schematic carved figures in a shallow relief idiom; there is no shared motif, relationship or layout, since B's ordered registers of tiny repeated signs have no counterpart in A's single freestanding figural mass.
